goal: Schritt 1: I68-Vertrag gegen TUI-ViewModels und Application-Reads prüfen | Schritt 2: ausschließlich den dünnen TuiCatalogReadAdapter plus fokussierte Contract-Tests implementieren

guide_delta.summary: Der Adapter projiziert vorhandene CatalogService-Reads in TUI-ViewModels und reicht Health/Event aus getrennt injizierten Read-Quellen durch. Er öffnet weder SQL noch Runtime oder Composition Root.

tests_required: compile read_adapter.py and focused adapter test
project category and entry reads to NavItem
project field/value reads to FieldRow without SQL
delegate HealthItem and EventItem sources without redefining semantics
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because the change is one isolated read adapter
TUI runtime tests because runtime wiring is explicitly excluded
browser tests because Web is untouched
database/repository tests because CP-03 and storage are untouched
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: value formatting is intentionally TUI-local until measurable cross-UI duplication justifies a neutral shared projection
health/event source lifecycle remains deferred to Composition Root
non_changes: no TUI runtime or Composition Root changes
no dependencies or CI workflow changes
expected_side_effects: a concrete productive TuiDataPort-compatible read adapter exists
